query:
SELECT vg.id, vg.variety_id, vg.parent_variety_id, vg.relation_type,
  v1.name as variety_name, v2.name as parent_name
FROM variety_genealogy vg
LEFT JOIN plant_varieties v1 ON v1.id = vg.variety_id
LEFT JOIN plant_varieties v2 ON v2.id = vg.parent_variety_id
WHERE v1.id IS NULL OR v2.id IS NULL
LIMIT 20;
